prompt: Our MLOps team needs a formal routing decision record for today's AI model usage. We have a quota monitoring tool set up in the workspace. Please run it to check the current quota levels across all providers, then produce a file called `model_routing_decision.json` that documents which specific model should be used right now for (1) coding/debugging work and (2) complex reasoning/analysis work. The file should reflect the actual current quota levels — not just the default first-choice models. Some models may be too depleted to use.
